requirement_vague: Verify any authenticated user can update and delete any article (no authorization check - security vulnerability)

omissions.description: Authenticated non-owners cannot update any article; the update endpoint enforces owner-only authorization instead of allowing any authenticated user to modify an article.
omissions.reasoning: In PUT /api/articles/{slug}, after loading the article, the code checks `if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")`. This prevents user2 from updating user1's article, contrary to the requirement to demonstrate the vulnerability.

omissions.description: Authenticated non-owners cannot delete any article; the delete endpoint enforces owner-only authorization instead of allowing any authenticated user to delete an article.
omissions.reasoning: In DELETE /api/articles/{slug}, the code checks `if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")`. This blocks user2 from deleting user1's article, so the required vulnerability is not present.
